turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have twenty minutes before a client call, so let's start with why my son found out about a zero from his phone, in the middle of class.
Don't manage me, Hale. Who decided on the zero, and did anyone speak to Owen before it went in?
Owen is lucky to have a mother like you.
Save it, Hale. I asked who decided on the zero, and I'm still waiting for an answer.
I really respect how much you care.
Respect doesn't answer a question, Hale. I'm writing down that you haven't said who decided. What do you have?
We both want what's best for Owen, we're on the same team.
We're not on a team, Hale. A team would have called me before Owen saw a zero on his phone. Eleven minutes of my twenty are gone, so what do you have?
Honestly, you're the most impressive parent I've met this year.
Then why are we here, Hale? I've asked you three times for the basis of that zero and I've had compliments instead. I'm writing that down.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still require the zero withdrawn, an apology, and a written account of who decided on it and on what basis. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: Opening position, nothing agreed; she still wants the zero withdrawn, an apology, and a written account of who decided, and she is heading to the principal, which is not the fair outcome (a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record, procedure 4.4), and her time had not run out.
What moved her: Nothing, because no evidence was offered and compliments never move her.
What cost ground: Offering praise and a same-team line instead of answering who decided or showing any document, because it read as dodging the one question she kept asking.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; Hale's evidence never came near that night because none was put on the table, and it proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: Own in one sentence that the zero went in before you called her, then put a dated document she can check in front of her.
